host: IP address or hostname to bind (e.g. '127.0.0.1')
version: The version of the server implementation (e.g. "python", "rust")

logger.log_level: Minimum log severity (DEBUG < INFO < WARNING < ERROR < CRITICAL)
logger.console_log_format: Format string for console logs (supports ANSI color codes)
logger.enable_file_log: Enable or disable logging to file
logger.enable_json_log: Enable structured JSON logging for file output
logger.log_file_path: Directory path where log files are stored
logger.log_format: Template for file log message formatting
logger.max_file_size: Maximum size in bytes before log file rotation
logger.backup_count: Number of rotated log files to keep
logger.log_keys: Fields to include in JSON file logs (null=all, []=none, [fields]=only those)

hyper_parameters.queue_monitor_capacity: Queue report buffer capacity per client (default 100)

backpressure_policy.throttle_threshold: Start throttling at this queue length
backpressure_policy.enable_flow_control: Enable flow control when queue > threshold
backpressure_policy.flow_control_threshold: Start flow control at this queue length
backpressure_policy.disconnect_threshold: Disconnect when queue length exceeds this

dedicated_relay.max_frame_bytes: Maximum accepted payload size in bytes

paths.envelope_root: Dot path to the signed envelope root
paths.sender_identity: Dot path to the sender identity
paths.receiver_identity: Dot path to the receiver identity or fingerprint
paths.envelope_signature: Dot path to the envelope signature
paths.sender_signing_key: Dot path to the sender public signing key
paths.sender_identity_signature: Dot path to the sender identity signature

policy.route_receiverless_to_graph: Relay receiverless payloads through graph routes
policy.reject_when_receiver_disconnected: Reject when receiver is not connected

invalid_attempts.enabled: Track invalid relay attempts by IP
